title: db_integration_test.TC-DB-02-04: connection-pool-boundary test flakes under concurrent-binary contention (split from ISS-0150/GH#482)
symptom: TC-DB-02-04 ('invalid pool_size returns InvalidPoolSize; boundary values succeed') fails intermittently during zig build test-integration. Observed failing in 1 of 3 runs, passing in 2. Failure mode: Pool.init(pool_size=200) returns PoolError.ConnectionFailed instead of succeeding, causing `try Pool.init(...)` to propagate the error and fail the test.
reproduction: Run zig build test-integration while other test binaries are active (i.e. as part of a full integration suite invocation, not in isolation). The failure occurs only when >50 connections are already held by concurrent binaries against the db_test database.
root_cause_analysis: Pool.init() opens all pool_size connections eagerly in a loop (src/db/pool.zig:~line 757: `pg.Conn.connectUrl(io, allocator, config.url) catch return PoolError.ConnectionFailed`). TC-DB-02-04 calls Pool.init with pool_size=200, which requires 200 free PostgreSQL connections. docker-compose.yml sets max_connections=250 for db_test. When zig build test-integration runs all test binaries concurrently, each binary holds 1+ connections via TestHarness and pool_size=5 pools. With 20+ concurrent binaries, aggregate connection count often exceeds 50, leaving fewer than 200 free slots. When the 200th connectUrl call hits the limit, PostgreSQL rejects with 'too many connections', which pg.Conn.connectUrl surfaces as an error, and Pool.init returns ConnectionFailed rather than the expected success.
pre_existing_evidence: Recorded as 'additional_flaky_finding' in ISS-0150 (GH #482) on 2026-08-06. Accepted criteria in ISS-0150 item 3: 'TC-DB-02-04 either made deterministic or its connection-pressure sensitivity documented and bounded'. Not addressed in WF03-ISS-0150-20260807 (per step-07-doc-updater.json: 'acceptance criterion 3 (TC-DB-02-04 determinism) was not reached in this run').
evidence: ISS-0150.json additional_flaky_finding field: 'observed failing in 1 of 3 runs'.
handoffs/WF03-gh477-20260806/step-03-backend-dev.json: 'TC-DB-02-04 is flaky, not a regression: it appeared in 1 of 3 runs and was absent in 2 repeats.'

Pool.init source (src/db/pool.zig ~line 734): pool_size validated first (< 2 or > 200 → InvalidPoolSize), then all pool_size connections opened eagerly in loop — no conditional path to skip network calls when pool_size is in-range.
docker-compose.yml line 60: max_connections=250 for db_test service.

makePool() helper in db_integration_test.zig opens pool_size=5; other integration binaries each open similar pools; 20+ concurrent binaries × 1-5 connections each = 20-100 aggregate connections, which eats into the 250-slot budget.
acceptance_criteria: TC-DB-02-04 passes deterministically under zig build test-integration (full parallel suite), measured across 5 consecutive runs
The upper-boundary validation semantics (pool_size > 200 → InvalidPoolSize) remain covered
fix_scope: tests/integration/db_integration_test.zig — TC-DB-02-04: add pre-check querying pg_stat_activity count and SHOW max_connections before Pool.init(pool_size=200); compute safe_pool_size = min(200, max_conn - current_conn - 5); if safe_pool_size < 2 skip with diagnostic, otherwise use safe_pool_size for the upper-boundary live test. The pool_size=201 InvalidPoolSize check remains unchanged (no network call).
docker-compose.yml — raise db_test max_connections from 250 to 500 to reduce contention pressure in practice
